Sprii specializes in providing products for mums to help them bloom during their pregnancy. Stock up on baby essentials, kit themselves out for pre-natal Yoga, or create fun family moments together in the kitchen, Sprii is the shopping destination loved and trusted by mums all over the Middle East.

It was founded in 2014 and headquartered in Dubai, Dubai.
